name: doc-convert
title_zh: 本地把 Markdown 变成带图的 PDF 和 W
tagline_zh: Read 工具打不开的 PDF、docx、xlsx，先转成 Markdown 再读。
tagline_en: Read the PDF/docx/xlsx that Read can't open by converting to Markdown first; then render your Markdown into.
desc_en: Convert and ingest documents with local tools — no cloud. PRODUCE: Markdown → styled PDF in house style, with mermaid diagrams rendered, via the `md2pdf` command; Markdown → Word/.docx (and pptx/html/epub) via pandoc. INGEST: read a .pdf/.docx/.xlsx the Read tool can't handle by converting it to Markdown/text first (pandoc, PyMuPDF, python-docx, openpyxl). Trigger whenever the user says: "make a P
why_zh: 出稿和读稿走同一条本地管线：pandoc 管格式，PyMuPDF 管 PDF 取文。
why_en: One local pipeline for both directions: pandoc for formats, PyMuPDF for PDF text, md2pdf for house style — no cloud dependency.
limit_zh: 本机得装 pandoc、PyMuPDF、python-docx、openpyxl 和 md2pdf。
limit_en: Needs pandoc, PyMuPDF, python-docx, openpyxl and md2pdf installed locally; scanned PDFs without a text layer come out empty and need OCR first; only.
title_en: Turn Markdown into styled PDF and Word, fully offline
